say:1:1460433001:1.text: Based on Ravion's information and your own observations, you conclude that the patients' symptoms are primarily caused by changes in their social standing.
say:1:1460433001:1.source_cn: 根据沙利叶提供的信息，以及你的亲眼所见，你判断这次的患...

say:2:1460433002:1.text: Some get swept up in their elevated status, holding their heads high for so long that they end up with stiff necks.
say:2:1460433002:1.source_cn: 一部分人因为地位陡升而趾高气扬，导致脖颈酸痛。

say:3:1460433003:1.text: Others, having fallen from grace, grow anxious and dejected. After hunching over for too long, they suffer from lower back and leg pain.
say:3:1460433003:1.source_cn: 另一部分则因为地位一落千丈而变得惶恐不安，垂头丧气，腰...

say:4:1460433004:1.text: You decide to use what's available in the garden to prepare a recipe for them.
say:4:1460433004:1.source_cn: 你决定，从苗圃里现有的药材中挑选适合的来制作药剂。

say:5:1460433005:1.text: Firstly, the <style="highlight">parasol mushroom</style> is the key ingredient for both potions. It inspires the patients to pursue their dreams and face reality.
say:5:1460433005:1.source_cn: 首先，两种药剂都少不了的，就是<style=highl...

say:6:1460433006:1.text: For the arrogant patients, you need to add some <style="highlight">vita bitterberries</style> and <style="highlight">rock mushrooms</style> to remind them of humility.
say:6:1460433006:1.source_cn: 针对趾高气扬的患者，你需要一些<style=highl...

say:7:1460433007:1.text: For the anxious patients, you need to add some <style="highlight">jumping beans</style> and <style="highlight">pride antlers</style> to reignite their drive and courage.
say:7:1460433007:1.source_cn: 而面对惊恐畏缩的患者，你则需要<style=highl...

narration:8:1460433008:0.text: These are the recipes for the <style="highlight">Humility Tonic</style> and <style="highlight">Confidence Tonic</style>!
